mappings: Letter + origin
Sample story-prop copy; origin content/save binding is M1 work.
Train + platform
middlebury-station. Greeter: station-greeter / what-should-i-call-you. Sample journey framing.
Character
Name/pronouns are player inputs. Appearance and access controls are design specimens; preview Mobility variants show standing or wheelchair.
Escort + dialogue
welcome quest; middlebury-station → triangle-park → arrival-green → dorm-room. Topology compressed for play; not official geography.
Dorm + notice
dorm-room. Doodad slots and notice are design states. Reading notice does not start orientation.
Campus
proctor / davis-library. Buildings labeled sample; portrait is an original archetype.
Class + notebook
seminar-room, fys-instructor, sample-seminar-questions. Teacher text and shown response are verbatim lesson blocks/prompts. Player notes are a separate sample.
Town
downtown / movie-theater. Food is sample, without invented business names; Triangle Park threshold is game framing.
Seasons + Snow Bowl
snow-bowl; trip beyond town. Same map/ground seasonal variable; no quest changes.
Optional minigame + outcomes
Original sample balancing activity. Skip, finished, and missed states all continue to the trip.
